smartCommute.title: Smart Commute
smartCommute.vehicleUnavailable: That vehicle is unavailable. Select a vehicle explicitly; no other vehicle was selected.
smartCommute.chooseVehicle: Choose the vehicle whose routines you want to manage.
smartCommute.identityMissingDescription: Your authentication provider did not supply a verified identity.
smartCommute.changeFailed: The change was not saved. Refresh and try again.
smartCommute.suggestionUnavailable: This suggestion is no longer available. Refresh the action center.
smartCommute.localOnly: Local analysis examines up to eight weeks of this vehicle’s completed drives on this server. It does not identify the driver.

traffic.optional: Traffic checks are optional for each confirmed routine. A check never wakes or operates your vehicle.
traffic.notConfigured: HERE traffic checks are not configured on this server. Your routines still work locally.
traffic.reviewHelp: Choose one recent completed drive that follows this routine. Previewing reads its location points locally and does not contact HERE.
traffic.noDrives: There are no recent completed drives to review.
traffic.previewFailed: This drive could not be previewed. Choose a completed drive with recorded locations that matches the routine.
traffic.disclosure: When a check is due, HERE receives these exact coordinates and the planned departure time. It does not get the routine name, VIN, or other drives.
traffic.points: Coordinates that can be shared with HERE
traffic.lead: Check this many minutes before departure
traffic.allow: Allow sharing this trace with HERE for this routine
traffic.expired: This comparison is no longer available. You may have left or the traffic evidence may have expired.
traffic.evidence: HERE traffic observed {{observed}} for departure at {{departure}}.
traffic.teslaRoute: These are estimates, not measured trip times. Tesla calculates its own route.
traffic.actionSummary: HERE estimates {{usual}} min on the usual route and {{alternative}} min on an alternative.
traffic.coverage: Both routes had fresh directional HERE Traffic Flow coverage
traffic.actionTitle: A faster route is available before your departure
traffic.rationale: Fresh HERE Traffic Flow covered both routes; the estimated difference exceeds your selected threshold.

deadline.help: Set a time within six hours after departure in {{zone}}, or leave it blank. This stays in TeslaSync and does not require calendar access.
deadline.disclosure: If an earlier departure may help, TeslaSync also asks HERE for an estimate at that departure time. The deadline itself is not sent.
deadline.recommendation: Estimated latest departure: {{latest}}. Your arrival deadline: {{deadline}}.
deadline.limitations: TeslaSync works backward from the fastest qualifying estimate and adds a three-minute buffer. Traffic at an earlier departure may differ.
deadline.title: Leave earlier to make your arrival deadline
deadline.rationale: Even the fastest qualifying estimate misses your deadline at the planned departure time.

delivery.pushBody: Open TeslaSync to review a route comparison.
delivery.help: Commute push starts off and only applies to routines with approved traffic checks. Enable it from the browser that should receive it. This replaces the previous commute recipient without changing charging notifications.
delivery.unavailable: Commute push requires configured HERE traffic checks and shared live signals.

smartCommute.enable: Enable Smart Commute for this vehicle
smartCommute.enableHint: Enable this vehicle’s commute settings and routines.
smartCommute.localAnalysis: Allow local analysis of completed drives
smartCommute.localAnalysisHint: Use this vehicle’s completed drives on this server to suggest routines.
smartCommute.pauseHint: Temporarily pause Smart Commute without deleting your routines.
smartCommute.deleteDescription: This turns the feature off and deletes your routines and decisions for this vehicle. Your original drives are not deleted.
smartCommute.deleteRoutineDescription: The saved routine will be removed. Your original drives are not deleted.
smartCommute.noRoutines: No routine is saved or awaiting review. Enable local analysis or add one manually.
smartCommute.question: Is this your regular {{day}} drive?
smartCommute.actionSummary_one: {{count}} matching departure day between {{start}} and {{end}} ({{zone}}). Candidate destination: {{destination}}.
smartCommute.actionSummary_other: {{count}} matching departure days between {{start}} and {{end}} ({{zone}}). Candidate destination: {{destination}}.
smartCommute.actionRationale: Locally analyzed completed drives have similar departure times and endpoints.
smartCommute.actionBasisSample: At least seven distinct local days within a bounded eight-week window
smartCommute.actionBasisDriver: Similar endpoints and departure times do not identify the driver
smartCommute.actionLimitationIdentity: The driver and destination name are not inferred.
smartCommute.actionLimitationWrites: This suggestion does not send notifications or operate the vehicle.

actionFreshness.fresh: Evidence is within the provider's fresh window
actionFreshness.unknown: Unknown observation age reduces confidence by 0.22

smartCommute.evidence_one: {{count}} matching day, departures between {{start}} and {{end}}. Last observed {{last}}.
smartCommute.evidence_other: {{count}} matching days, departures between {{start}} and {{end}}. Last observed {{last}}.
smartCommute.formPrivacy: These coordinates stay on this server. Saving a routine does not send a notification or command.
smartCommute.name: Routine name
smartCommute.invalidForm: Enter a name, valid local time, time zone and coordinates.
